# Len Norman

Len Norman is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 1983.

Len Norman has participated in 5 elections since 2002:

- [**2002 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/len-norman#e2)

  Elected as Senator with 48.4% of the ballot.
- [**2008 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/len-norman#e11)

  Elected as Connétable of St Clement with 60.9% of the vote.

  - [2008 Full Manifesto](http://jerseyelections.info/constables/len-norman.html)
- [**2011 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/len-norman#e14)

  Elected as Connétable of St Clement unopposed.
- [**2014 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/len-norman#e21)

  Elected as Connétable of St Clement unopposed.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/len-norman/)
- [**2018 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/len-norman#e43)

  Elected as Connétable of St Clement unopposed.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/len-norman-2/)

### 2008 Connétables Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St Clement](https://flow.je/elections/st-clement) (1 seat), 15th October 2008.

**Len Norman was elected as Connétable of St Clement in 2008**.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Len Norman** |  | 1,593 | 60.9% |

| 3 | [Edgar Wallis](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/edgar-wallis) |  | 254 | 9.7% |

2,615 votes (inc. 28 spoilt papers)
